title: PBMC_BD_1
treatment_protocol_ch1: PBMCs were isolated from blood by density gradient centrifugation and then resuspended in PBS. Monocytes were positively isolated by CD14 MicroBeads (Miltenyi Biotec) according to the manufacturer's instructions.
extract_protocol_ch1: The cell suspension was loaded into Chromium microfluidic chips with 3’ chemistry and barcoded with a 10× Chromium Controller (10X Genomics). RNA from the barcoded cells was subsequently reverse-transcribed and sequencing libraries constructed with reagents from a Chromium Single Cell 3’ v2 reagent kit (10X Genomics) according to the manufacturer’s instructions
RNA libraries were prepared using standard 10X genomics protocols were sequenced on Illumina NovaSeq 6000.
data_processing: The Cellranger software suite (https://support.10xgenomics.com/single-cell-gene- expression/software/pipelines/latest/what-is-cell-ranger) from 10X was used to demultiplex cellular barcodes, align reads to the human genome (GRCh38 ensemble, http://useast.ensembl.org/Homo_sapiens/Info/Index) and perform UMI counting
Supplementary files format and content: Tar files of filtered feature-barcode matrix (output of CellRanger)  and csv file of sample information
contact_address: No1 ShuaiFuYuan，Dong Cheng District ，Beijing, Beijing, CN
